summary: A 48-year-old woman from Phoenix became separated from her son while hiking the Woods Lake trail near Telluride, not equipped for an overnight stay; San Miguel County SAR launched a multi-agency search with Dolores County SAR and found her safe ~10:33pm near the Woods Lake/Navajo Lake trail junction at ~11,200 ft; she was uninjured but cold and disoriented; escorted out via Navajo Lake trail.
location: Woods Lake / Navajo Lake trails, Lizard Head Wilderness (found in Dolores County)
responding_agency: San Miguel County Search and Rescue, Dolores County Search and Rescue
notes: Reported missing Tuesday evening Jun 9, 2026; located after ~2-hr search; lead agency San Miguel County.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Lizard Head)
